text:
jordan_acme: Hey team — hitting flaky streaming in Safari with EventSource. Starts streaming fine, then ~30s later connection drops and we only get partial chunks. Works in Chrome. Using our CDN in front of Redwood. Repro steps: 1) open app in Safari 16.5 2) start /v1/streams?model=gptx 3) see first events then stops. No console errors.

support_bot: Thanks for reporting! A support engineer will pick this up shortly. Please include request headers and any HAR if possible. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex_k: Hi Jordan — do you send auth as Authorization header or cookie? Native EventSource can't set headers so are you using a polyfill? Also can you paste the response headers (first 2-3 responses) and whether you see 304s from the CDN?

jordan_acme: We use a polyfill (EventSourcePolyfill) because we need Bearer tokens. I dug up the network trace — looks like:

```
GET /v1/streams?model=gptx 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
cache-control: public, max-age=60
cf-cache-status: REVALIDATED
etag: "abc123"
transfer-encoding: chunked

...initial events...

GET /v1/streams?model=gptx 304 Not Modified
cf-cache-status: HIT
age: 12

--connection drops in Safari (no more events)
```

alex_k: Thanks — that pattern is telling. Safari + polyfill + CDN revalidation (304) is a known brittle combo. When the CDN answers a 304 midstream the XHR polyfill can close/finish the XHR which Safari then treats as a completed resource — leading to the EventSource dropping.

mira: Also check if your polyfill uses XHR responseType = 'text' + incremental read. Some polyfills rely on chunked Transfer-Encoding and will fail if the intermediary returns 304 without an actual body. Do you set Vary: Authorization or add Cache-Control: no-cache on the stream route?

jordan_acme: We currently set Cache-Control: public, max-age=60 to reduce load. We didn't set Vary.

samir_eng: Quick repro you can run locally (will show the same lifecycle):
```
# use curl to observe revalidate behavior
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=gptx"
```
If you see a 304 after the initial 200 in the trace, that's the issue. To reproduce with the polyfill: open Safari, load page, toggle offline/online quickly to force CDN revalidation.

alex_k: Short-term mitigations you can try:
- Disable CDN caching for the SSE path (Cache-Control: no-store or private, no-transform).
- Add Vary: Authorization so CDN doesn't revalidate the same cached object across tokens.
- Make the endpoint send Cache-Control: no-cache and use ETag but avoid returning 304 midstream.
- Add X-Accel-Buffering: no (nginx) / Connection: keep-alive and ensure chunked responses are flushed frequently.

mira: Another workaround is to use a signed short-lived query token instead of Authorization header so CDN treats each URL as unique and you avoid revalidation. Not ideal for all customers though.

jordan_acme: Ok will try no-store on /v1/streams. Two questions: 1) can Redwood set recommended headers automatically for streaming endpoints to avoid users shooting themselves in the foot? 2) Billing: this reconnection loop caused a lot of token refresh calls and extra billed tokens — is there anything on your side to reduce retry storms?

alex_k: Good questions. We can do two things: 1) add a public engineering doc + sample nginx/cloudfront config recommended for stream endpoints (Cache-Control: no-store, Content-Type: text/event-stream, Vary: Authorization if you must use headers). 2) I'll escalate to eng-runtime to add a default header set for managed streaming routes and create an internal ticket so Dedicated/Private customers can opt in. That should reduce accidental 304 revalidations.

samir_eng: Filed ENG-5421 to evaluate adding a header policy on the platform side. @mira can you pick up the investigation for whether our CDN (edge) performs revalidation for streaming routes by default?

mira: On it — will check config and whether we can flip a platform flag to disable caching for routes that declare text/event-stream.

jordan_acme: Thanks. I'll test the no-store change and post a HAR if it still happens. Appreciate the quick help. :thumbsup:

support_bot: Issue escalated to ENG-5421. If you can attach a HAR and repro steps that would help speed this up.

alex_k: One final note — if you need a temporary client-side patch, polyfill consumers can detect 304 and attempt to reopen using a query-token fallback. Not ideal but useful while we push the platform change.

jordan_acme: Will do. I'll update this thread after testing.
